summary: Allot Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, announcing Q2 2026 results and a $40 million share repurchase program approved by the Board on June 23, 2026. The program reflects management's confidence and capital return intention. No specific price per share or timing was provided. The company also raised 2026 revenue guidance to $115–$118 million. Over $100 million cash supports the buyback. Watch for execution pace and any impact on share price.
